description: Do we already know this person? Ask this ONCE with whatever you have instead of guessing which lookup to try: name, email, phone, social_url (a LinkedIn/GitHub/etc profile URL), external_chat_id, or a single unlabelled `handle` that is figured out from its shape. Checks channels, lead mail, contact mail, stored profile URLs and phone, compares URLs normalised (scheme, www., country subdomain, query, trailing slash and percent-encoding all ignored), and searches names by SURNAME because lead titles carry roles and companies. Returns candidates with a confidence and what matched. ALWAYS call this before writing to somebody for the first time — a hit means they are not a first contact.

handle.description: Unlabelled identifier (e-mail, phone, URL, chat id); its kind is detected from its shape

name.description: Person's name; matched mainly by surname

name: resolve_person
